changed.summary: This draft was auto-produced when massive-galaxy abundance surfaced as a top-ranked frontier — the pipeline pulled the data, drafted, and refereed it (machine detail behind the referee link).

Regenerated the manuscript applying the Quartet's edits: replaced the hand-waved '~1 dex' with an itemized six-axis stellar-mass budget (0.46-0.55 dex, 10 ADS-verified citations); pinned the TNG aperture to the observed total-mass basis from real TNG100-1 catalogs (+0.13 dex -> required shift 0.28->0.20 dex, result strengthens); added the epsilon=0.20 fiducial-LCDM benchmark and +0.70 dex falsification threshold; honestly demoted z~7-9 to outside-budget/marginal and added the 15-20-object Poisson caveat plus redshift-median framing. Descriptive - not validated.
